title: I made my first VR game for Meta Quest 3! Would love for you guys to check it out ($4.99)
author: javiergame4
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on my first VR game called **KEEP HOLDING**, and I wanted to share it with the community!

It's a VR climbing game where you get to experience some pretty crazy heights and environments. Right now, there are 3 different levels:

* 🗼 **The Tower** – Climb your way up a massive tower. Definitely not for people afraid of heights lol.
* 🏔️ **The Rock** – A rock climbing experience inspired by Guatapé, Colombia.
* 🌊 **The Deep** – An underwater cage ascent where you start deep in the ocean and slowly make your way to the surface. There's some creepy stuff down there too 👀

I also added multiplayer so you can climb with a friend, help each other out, or just mess around together 😂

It's currently **$4.99 on the Meta Quest Store**. I'm planning to keep improving it and adding more content based on feedback.

I'm a solo developer, so this has been a pretty fun learning experience. I'd genuinely love for some of you to try it out and hear what you think, even if it's criticism. I want to make the game better!

Here's the link if anyone wants to check it out:

[https://www.meta.com/experiences/keep-holding/1328249903712449/](https://www.meta.com/experiences/keep-holding/1328249903712449/)

  
Did this mostly with GPT astra. It's early access right now and definitely will improve via feedback. I wanted to make it an affordable experience and definitely will add more levels/content overtime.

comments.author: Caninetechnology
comments.body: Should put a trailer instead of just describing the game, looks fun though. How easy is it to get approved on Meta quest store?

replies.author: javiergame4
replies.body: you're right! I added trailer now. Also it's not that bad, my first time.  Make sure you have a website created with showing terms and conditions and etc and making sure you have a EIN/registered company.  Also make sure your game/app complies with laws and making sure you have the correct permissions set if it's for kids. It took me like a week to get approved since they kept blocking me until I fixed my terms and conditions.
